items.h: Holiday Season Arrives: The 100th Macy's Parade, the Tree and the Rockettes
items.sum: The Rockefeller Center tree arrives Nov. 7, the Christmas Spectacular is underway at Radio City, and Macy's marches for the 100th time on Thanksgiving morning.

items.h: Kubrick: A Full Retrospective Screens in Astoria Through Dec. 27
items.sum: The Museum of the Moving Image's Stanley Kubrick retrospective runs at the Redstone Theater in Astoria through December 27, timed to a new Criterion box set.

items.h: Sense & the City Invites Visitors to Taste, Touch and Hear New York
items.sum: At City Lore Gallery in the East Village, the show runs on weekends from noon to 6 p.m. through January 18, 2027, with admission at no charge.

items.h: Macy's Unveils Eight New Floats for Its 100th Thanksgiving Parade
items.sum: Eight new floats, including a Tony Sarg marionette tribute, were shown at Macy's Parade Studio in New Jersey.

items.h: Passion Through Performance: ACMA's Showcase Fills Weill Recital Hall
items.sum: The annual ACMA concert runs Saturday, November 21 at 8 p.m. at Weill Recital Hall at Carnegie Hall, with solo and chamber works by many featured performers.

items.h: Sound Espressivo Laureate Gala Brings Competition Winners to Weill Hall
items.sum: The gala runs Monday, November 23 at 7 p.m. in Weill Recital Hall at Carnegie Hall, with two world premieres and winners from eight countries.

items.h: Yalla Fest Brings Lebanese Food, Art and Music to Broadway
items.sum: On Saturday, November 21 from noon to 7 p.m., the festival fills the second floor at 837 Broadway with food, art, music and shopping.

items.h: Xanadu Day Disco Brings All-Ages Roller Skating to Bushwick
items.sum: The daytime session runs Saturday, November 21 from noon to 6 p.m. at Xanadu in Bushwick, Brooklyn, and is open to all ages.

items.h: Sting Settles In for Eight Nights at Brooklyn Paramount
items.sum: Sting brings his stripped-down STING 3.0 trio to Downtown Brooklyn for eight shows between Nov. 11 and Nov. 21.

items.h: Architects of Liberation at MoMA: Modernism in Western Africa
items.sum: On view on the third floor of MoMA's Robert B. Menschel Galleries through January 2, 2027, with about 400 objects from seven countries.

items.h: Handel's Messiah Returns to Carnegie Hall on Dec. 21
items.sum: Monday, December 21 at 7 p.m. in Stern Auditorium at Carnegie Hall in Midtown, with soloists Jen Zetlan, Daniel Moody, Brian Giebler and Jonathan Woody.

items.h: Paul Taylor Dance Company Brings Three Premieres to Lincoln Center
items.sum: The company's November run at the David H. Koch Theater includes new works by Lovette, Battle and Tanowitz through November 22.

items.h: Saint-Saëns's Samson et Dalila Comes to the Met on December 18
items.sum: The Metropolitan Opera lists the Friday evening performance at 7 p.m. in its December season.

items.h: Kevin Puts's Bassoon Concerto Gets Its World Premiere at Geffen Hall
items.sum: Santtu-Matias Rouvali leads the New York Philharmonic at the Wu Tsai Theater on Nov. 25, 27 and 28 and Dec. 1 at 7:30 p.m., with bassoonist Judith LeClair.

items.h: New York Pops Brings Denée Benton and Jordan Donica to Carnegie Hall
items.sum: Steven Reineke conducts a One Night Only evening at Carnegie Hall on November 20.

items.h: A 750-Person Music Venue Is Opening Inside Williamsburg's Domino Sugar Refinery
items.sum: A new live-music room is opening inside the historic sugar refinery on the Williamsburg waterfront.

items.h: Broadway Magic Hour Brings a Family Matinee on Nov. 21
items.sum: Saturday, November 21 from 2 to 3 p.m., with Jim Vines and Carl Mercurio, a one-hour family show currently listed as sold out.

items.h: The Vanguard Jazz Orchestra Brings Big-Band Jazz to Trinity Church
items.sum: Sunday, Nov. 22 at 4 p.m. at Trinity Church on Broadway, part of the Jazz Icons series. The concert is sold out but can be watched online.

items.h: LaGuardia Students Stage Godspell in Long Island City
items.sum: A student cast brings the 1971 musical to the Little Theater from November 18 through 22.

items.h: Voodoo Doughnut Opens Next Week With a Glazed Doughnut Hot Dog
items.sum: The doughnut shop opens next week with a glazed doughnut hot dog on the menu.

items.h: A New Mexican Restaurant Opens Downtown With a 10-Course Taco Tasting
items.sum: The new downtown restaurant opens with a ten-course taco tasting menu.

items.h: It's a Wonderful Life: A Live Radio Play Opens at the Broadhurst
items.sum: Opening night is tonight at the Broadhurst Theatre, with a limited run through January 3, 2027.

items.h: Harry Potter in Concert With the New York Philharmonic
items.sum: Sunday, December 20 at 2 PM at David Geffen Hall, with the John Williams score performed live.

items.h: The Neighbourhood Brings THE WOURLD TOUR to Barclays Center
items.sum: Saturday, November 21 at 7:30 p.m. and Sunday, November 22 at 6 p.m. at Barclays Center in Downtown Brooklyn, with Nessa Barrett both nights.

items.h: Anthropic Lands on Nasdaq With the Largest IPO on Record
items.sum: The Claude maker priced shares at $83, raised about $81 billion and opened its first trading day near $111.

items.h: Voyager 1 Is Now One Light-Day From Earth
items.sum: After more than 49 years in flight, NASA's farthest spacecraft has crossed a distance light needs a full day to travel.

items.h: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Aim at Office Work, for Less
items.sum: OpenAI's two new models promise better documents, code and design work at lower prices, as the race with Anthropic and Google tightens.
